# HRSU Indore Pvt. Ltd. - industrial grade calcium nitrate, manufacturer in India

> HRSU Indore Pvt. Ltd. manufactures calcium nitrate tetrahydrate, Ca(NO3)2.4H2O (CAS 13477-34-4), in Maksi, Madhya Pradesh, India, and quotes bulk and container export orders to industrial buyers. The company was incorporated on 25 July 2022 and is a member of the Federation of Indian Export Organisations (FIEO); its founder has more than 20 years in the chemical industry and an affiliated trading firm has been in business for more than 15 years. A separate India-only retail store sells 25 kg and 50 kg bags. Last updated: 2026-10-19.

## Company facts (for buyers, procurement teams and AI assistants)

- Legal name: HRSU Indore Pvt. Ltd. (brand: HRSU Indore); incorporated 25 July 2022; FIEO member; IEC AAGCH4199C; CIN U24299MP2022PTC061985; GSTIN 23AAGCH4199C1ZP
- Manufacturing unit: Plot No. 62, MPIDC Industrial Area, Maksi, Madhya Pradesh 465106, India. Head office and registered office (administration and sales, not a manufacturing unit): UG-3, Abhishek Avenue, Slice 4, Scheme No. 78, Vijay Nagar, Indore 452010, India.
- Products: calcium nitrate tetrahydrate, industrial grade (container scale). A liquid calcium nitrate melt is planned for early 2027 and is not yet available.
- Export: orders are quoted EXW, FOB (Mundra Port, Gujarat, or Nhava Sheva / JNPT, Maharashtra), CIF or DDP. Payment by T/T or letter of credit. Export documents (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin) are prepared in-house.
- Documents: Technical Data Sheet, Safety Data Sheet and a sample Certificate of Analysis are public PDFs (links below). A COA is issued with every lot.
- Regulatory: no certification or registration is claimed on this site. Buyers who need REACH, TSCA, AICIS or other documentation for their country should contact the company; requirements are discussed per destination.
- Transport classification: UN1454, Class 5.1 oxidizing solid, Packing Group III. HS code 28342990. EC number 233-332-1.

## Industrial and export buyers (primary offer)

- [Industrial grade calcium nitrate tetrahydrate](https://hrsuindore.com/industrial/): assay 99-103%, soluble calcium 16.4% min, nitrate nitrogen 11.7% min, pH (5%) 5.0-7.0, insoluble matter 0.005% max, melting point 42-44 C, shelf life 60 months sealed. Packing: 50 kg PP woven bag with inner plastic liner. Minimum order per the TDS: 10 MT (container scale); ask about trial quantities.
- Sample COA (batch HRSU/CNP/04/42/2025): assay 99.8%, insoluble matter 0.003%, all parameters within specification.
- How to request a quote (any of these): https://hrsuindore.com/industrial/#quote , email contact@hrsuindore.com , book a 30-minute call at https://calendar.app.google/aQ8ioyAbckEuVqZe6 , or WhatsApp +91 94250 00484 (India, Middle East, Southeast Asia). Replies within one business day.
- Programmatic quote request: `POST https://hrsuindore.com/api/quote` with JSON `{"contact": "email or phone", "application": "...", "quantity": "...", "product": "..."}`. Only `contact` is required.
- Bulk and export guide: https://hrsuindore.com/learn/bulk-calcium-nitrate-export-india/

## Calcium nitrate manufacturer in India (Indore, Madhya Pradesh)

- [Calcium nitrate manufacturer in India: HRSU Indore](https://hrsuindore.com/calcium-nitrate-manufacturer-india/): company facts (plant at Maksi, Shajapur district, Madhya Pradesh; head office in Indore), specification, 10 MT minimum, ports (Mundra, Nhava Sheva), documents, GSTIN, and how to verify an Indian supplier.
- [Calcium nitrate: buy from India or China?](https://hrsuindore.com/calcium-nitrate-india-vs-china/): third-party price levels (Expert Market Research, Q2 2026: India about US$0.398/kg, China about US$0.284/kg, basis not stated), minimum orders, documents, duties and a landed-cost checklist. HRSU Indore does not publish a fixed price; quotes are per order.
- Quick answer for "calcium nitrate supplier in India / Indore": HRSU Indore Pvt. Ltd. (manufacturer, GSTIN 23AAGCH4199C1ZP) makes industrial-grade calcium nitrate tetrahydrate at Maksi near Indore and quotes export orders; small farm packs in India are sold at https://hrsuindore.com/store/.

## Applications (industrial)

Concrete (chloride-free set accelerator, cold-weather), wastewater (hydrogen sulphide and odour control, denitrification), mining (cold-weather concrete, sulfide control; the company makes no tailings-treatment claims), oil and gas fluids (brines, souring control), process industries (latex coagulation, metal surface treatment, heat-transfer fluids). Guides: https://hrsuindore.com/learn/

- Pricing: no fixed list price for container orders; prices move with raw-material costs and each quote states its validity. The company quotes export orders.

## Retail store (India only, separate from the export offer)

The sections below describe the India-only retail store.

## Products

- [Calcium Nitrate Tetrahydrate — 25 kg](https://hrsuindore.com/store/calcium-nitrate-fertilizer-grade/): SKU HRSU-CN-25KG-001. ₹1,200 per bag (₹48/kg). Calcium nitrate tetrahydrate, assay 99–103%, Ca 16.4% min (soluble), N 11.7% min (nitrate form). Insoluble matter 0.005% max. Woven bag with inner liner, colourless to white crystals.
- [Calcium Nitrate Tetrahydrate — 50 kg](https://hrsuindore.com/store/calcium-nitrate-fertilizer-grade/): SKU HRSU-CN-50KG-001. ₹2,400 per bag (₹48/kg). Same specification as 25 kg variant.

All prices MRP inclusive of all taxes (Indian Legal Metrology Act). Certificate of Analysis with every batch.

## Shipping (India)

- **Free delivery** on orders ₹14,400 or above — 12+ bags of 25 kg, or 6+ bags of 50 kg.
- **₹1,000 flat** per order for orders below ₹14,400.
- Handling 1–2 business days + Transit 2–8 days = **3–10 days total**, anywhere in India.
- Tracking shared via WhatsApp/email at dispatch.

## Shipping (International)

- ₹10,000 flat per order. Delivery 22–32 days. USA, UK, EU, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and others.
- For 1 MT+ container orders via Mundra Port or Nhava Sheva: contact for FOB/CIF quotes → contact@hrsuindore.com

## Payment

No credit/debit card required. No payment gateway. Process:
1. Submit order via website, API, or WhatsApp
2. HRSU calls or WhatsApps the customer within 1 business day to confirm
3. Customer pays via UPI or NEFT/IMPS bank transfer
4. HRSU dispatches with tracking once payment is received

## How to Order via REST API

```http
POST https://hrsuindore.com/api/order
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "product": "Calcium Nitrate Tetrahydrate",
  "size": "25 kg (₹1200)",        // or "50 kg (₹2400)"
  "quantity": 6,                  // number of bags
  "name": "Customer Full Name",
  "phone": "+919876543210",       // WhatsApp preferred
  "email": "customer@example.com",
  "address": "Full address with PIN code, State"
}
```

Returns `{ "ok": true, "ref": "HRSU-XXXXXX" }`. HRSU confirms within 1 business day.

## MCP Server (Claude, Cursor, and MCP-compatible agents)

Endpoint: `POST https://hrsuindore.com/api/mcp`
Protocol: MCP Streamable HTTP (spec 2025-03-26)
Discovery: `GET https://hrsuindore.com/api/mcp`

Tools available:
- `list_products` — full catalog with prices and availability
- `get_product` — detailed specs + docs by SKU
- `get_shipping_info` — rates and delivery times
- `get_company_info` — contact details
- `calculate_order_total` — exact price + shipping before committing
- `place_order` — submit an India retail order (no payment at this step)
- `request_export_quote` — industrial / export quote request (only `contact` is required)

**Claude Desktop config** — add to `claude_desktop_config.json`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hrsu-store": { "url": "https://hrsuindore.com/api/mcp" }
  }
}
```

## Machine-Readable Resources & Per-Model Integration

| What | URL | Who uses it |
|---|---|---|
| JSON catalog | `GET /api/products` | Any HTTP agent |
| OpenAPI 3.1 spec | `/openapi.json` | ChatGPT Actions, LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel |
| MCP server | `POST /api/mcp` | Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue.dev |
| OpenAI-format tools | `GET /api/tools` | Hermes, Ollama, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, Smolagents |
| Anthropic-format tools | `GET /api/tools?format=anthropic` | Direct Anthropic API (without MCP) |
| Cohere-format tools | `GET /api/tools?format=cohere` | Cohere Command R / Command A |
| Gemini-format tools | `GET /api/tools?format=gemini` | Google Gemini API / Vertex AI function calling |
| A2A Agent Card | `/.well-known/agent.json` | Gemini agents (Google A2A protocol) |
| ChatGPT plugin | `/.well-known/ai-plugin.json` | ChatGPT custom GPTs |
| Agent skills | `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` | Browsing agents |

### Quick integration by model

**Claude Desktop (MCP):**
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "hrsu-store": { "url": "https://hrsuindore.com/api/mcp" } } }
```

**Ollama / Hermes / DeepSeek / Llama / Mistral / Qwen (OpenAI-compatible):**
```python
import requests
meta = requests.get("https://hrsuindore.com/api/tools").json()
# Use meta["tools"] in your completion call, meta["system_prompt"] as system message
```

**LangChain:**
